newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates rise on tax payment, end at 24pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates rise on tax payment, end at 24pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates closed higher on Monday as demand for money had been increased by social security contribution and VAT payments due on October 20, dealers said.
"The rates rose because of the tax day of October 20," said Postabank's Karoly Barath.
The overnight rates opened at 23.5 percent and closed at 24 percent.
Dealers said the overnight rates could go down to 23 to 23.25 percent this week.
However, they added that the liquidity of the market in the next few weeks would depend on how much money flowed in one-month reverse repo deals with the central bank in the past two weeks.
Substantial funds could flow in one-month reverse repo deals in the past two weeks as several market players expected a repo cut which did not come, dealers said.
